text: 中国财政部发行3年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.2522%，边际利率1.2747%，预期1.2600%，投标倍数3.15倍，边际倍数4.09倍； 中国财政部发行20年期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率2.0649%，预期2.0700%，投标倍数10.48倍，边际倍数1.04倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 3-year bonds in the amount of 120 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 1.2522%, a marginal rate of 1.2747%, an expected rate of 1.2600%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.15 times, and a marginal ratio of 4.09 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 20-year bonds in the amount of 20 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 2.0649%, an expected rate of 2.0700%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 10.48 times, and a marginal ratio of 1.04 times.
